notes: Idol of Endurance: 'Until end of turn, you may cast a creature spell from among cards exiled with this artifact without paying its mana cost.' A permission changes where a card is cast from, not when (CR 601.3; a creature is cast in its controller's main phase with an empty stack, CR 302.1). On the opponent's turn the activation is legal and paid, but the menu does not offer Walking Corpse (no flash), so it stays in exile. Ontology round R13: the activation makes a PERMIT; the cast is a menu row through it (cast:<card>:via:<idol>).
